name: prompt-examples
title: Prompt examples
description: What an AI feature can do, shown as written prompts and answers, with a tab per task and a Try this prompt action.
docs: Pass title, description and examples (three to five, each with an id, a tab label and optional icon, the prompt, the answer and an optional note), and onTry to hand a prompt to your product; without onTry the action is not shown. The answer is any content you write, dressed as prose, so plain paragraphs, lists and strong text are enough and a Table sits in it as it is. Static and honest: nothing is generated, so it needs no key and has no rate limit, and a note such as Example output, edited for length is only shown when you pass one. The tabs are real tabs with arrow keys and roving focus, controlled with value and onValueChange or left to open on defaultValue. All the panels share one cell of a grid and only the open one is visible, so the section is as tall as its tallest answer and nothing below it jumps; the closed answers stay in the page but are hidden from the screen and the keyboard. Tab icons show from 512px of width, and below 340px the tabs give up some padding and a point of type so all four fit on a small phone. Try this prompt always sits at the end of its line, with or without a note, and a panel's focus outline wraps its own answer. labels translates the fixed words.
